title: Novena Prayer to St. Jude
text:
Most holy Apostle, St. Jude,
faithful servant and friend of Jesus,
the Church honors and invokes you universally
as the patron of hopeless cases,
of things almost despaired of.
Pray for me, I am so helpless and alone.

Intercede with God for me
that He bring visible and speedy help
where help is almost despaired of.
Come to my assistance in this great need
that I may receive the consolation
and help of heaven in all my necessities,
tribulations, and sufferings,
particularly [mention your request],
and that I may praise God with you and all the saints
forever.

I promise, O blessed St. Jude,
to be ever mindful of this great favor
granted me by God
and to always honor you
as my special and powerful patron,
and to gratefully encourage devotion to you.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Sanctissime Apostole, Sancte Iuda,
fidelis serve et amice Iesu,
Ecclesia te honorat et invocat universaliter
tanquam patronum casuum desperatorum,
rerum fere desperatarum.
Ora pro me, tam inops et solus sum.

Intercede apud Deum pro me
ut Ipse adferat visibile et veloce auxilium
ubi auxilium fere desperatur.
Veni in auxilium meum in hac magna necessitate
ut consolationem accipiam
et auxilium caeli in omnibus necessitatibus meis,
tribulationibus et passionibus,
praesertim [mentio petitionem tuam],
et ut Deum laudem tecum et omnibus sanctis
in perpetuum.
Amen.

attribution: Traditional Novena Prayer to St. Jude
notes: St. Jude Thaddeus, one of the twelve apostles, is the patron saint of hopeless causes and desperate situations. This is the traditional novena prayer, often prayed for nine consecutive days for urgent needs. St. Jude's name was often confused with Judas Iscariot, leading to his being 'forgotten,' which is why he became the saint to turn to when all else fails.
description: Traditional novena prayer to St. Jude for hopeless causes
